hero.label: GIA — DIGITAL MARKETING ADVISORY
hero.headline: Better Marketing Starts With Better Decisions.
hero.supportingText: We help businesses turn marketing into a connected system — from strategy and customer acquisition to lead management, conversion, and growth.

intro.headline: Marketing Should Work As A System.
body: Marketing is more than content, campaigns, or advertising.
Your strategy, marketing channels, lead generation, customer relationships, and conversion process should work together.
GIA brings these areas together to help businesses make better decisions, build stronger marketing systems, and create sustainable growth.

approach.headline: We Don't Start With A Channel. We Start With The Business.
approach.intro: We first understand business objectives, market, customers, challenges, and opportunities before recommending a single channel or tactic.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: We start by understanding your business, market, and customers before anything else.

steps.title: Strategize
steps.description: We translate that understanding into a clear marketing and growth strategy.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: We bring the strategy to life across the right channels and systems.

steps.title: Measure
steps.description: We track performance against the objectives that matter to your business.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: We use what we learn to refine the approach and compound results over time.

servicesSection.headline: What We Do
servicesSection.intro: We bring together the strategic, marketing, growth, and creative capabilities businesses need to move forward.

growthSystem.headline: Marketing Shouldn't Stop At The Lead.
body: Generating a lead is only the beginning.
The real opportunity comes from what happens next.
GIA helps businesses connect marketing with the systems needed to capture, qualify, manage, follow up, and convert opportunities.

acquisitionSystem.headline: One System, From Click To Customer.
acquisitionSystem.intro: Whether traffic comes from Google, Meta, or another channel, the same question matters: what happens after someone clicks. GIA connects acquisition to what comes next.

integrationEcosystem.headline: Built To Work With The Tools You Already Use.
integrationEcosystem.intro: Marketing doesn't happen in one place. GIA connects strategy and execution across the acquisition, CRM, and automation platforms already running in your business.
integrationEcosystem.disclaimer: Platforms are shown to illustrate ecosystem compatibility only. GIA is not an official, certified, or technology partner of any platform listed unless explicitly stated.

whyGia.headline: A More Connected Way To Grow.

principles.title: Business First

principles.title: Strategy + Execution

principles.title: Connected Systems

principles.title: Measurable Thinking

industriesSection.headline: Different Businesses. Different Challenges.
industriesSection.intro: We don't believe effective marketing starts with a fixed industry formula. It starts with understanding the business.

finalCta.headline: Let's Talk About Your Business.
finalCta.body: Tell us where your business is today, where you want to go, and what you're trying to solve. We'll start with the conversation.
